name: 05_diff_exactly_zero_resets
description: [H2] System-A gate fails (weighted_vwap_diff EXACTLY 0.0 fails the strict `< 0` gate) so System A resets; System B is DECOUPLED and arms on its own condition (current_return -2.0 <= bleed_arm -1.0).
derivation: Outer guard passes. System-A gate: `weighted_vwap_diff < 0` -> 0.0 < 0 is FALSE (strict). System A resets vwap_ticks to 0 (confirms diff gate uses `<` not `<=`). [H2 DECOUPLING] System B independent: arm -2.0 <= -1.0 TRUE -> new_vwap_bleed_ticks = 1+1 = 2; is_vwap_bleed_broken = (2 >= 3) FALSE. Returns (0, 2, False, False). Pre-H2 wrongly expected (0,0,False,False).
